description: Clear timed slime after resistant iron-golem fire damage and emit the cure message.
Healthy iron-golem fire retains its existing outputs without a slime-cure message.
Clear timed slime after nonresistant minotaur fire damage and emit the cure message.
Healthy minotaur fire retains its existing outputs without a slime-cure message.
Looking while slimed as an iron golem leaves the slime timer and fire trap unchanged.
Looking while slimed as a minotaur leaves the slime timer and fire trap unchanged.
